title.narrative: Home Gardening for Mother Support Groups in three localities Rabak, Aljabalain and Gutina in WN

description.narrative:
Through support from CAFOD, Caritas Sudan has established a Community-Based Nutrition Management Programme in Alkawah, Al Jabalain, and Rabak. The project has facilitated the training of Community Nutrition Volunteers (CNVs) and Mother Support Groups (MSGs), including the establishment of an Outpatient Therapeutic Program (OTP) in Alkawah.
To further strengthen the response and address dietary challenges at the community level, there is a need to integrate food security activities into the ongoing community-based nutrition management initiatives. This integration aims to deliver comprehensive and sustainable interventions that tackle the root causes of malnutrition and enhance community resilience.
The project seeks to link nutrition program beneficiaries with livelihood opportunities, provide tools and skills for achieving sustainable food security through home gardening, to enhance the delivery of the community-based nutrition interventions with a focus on nutrition education, and agricultural support.
